data.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
(None directly — infrastructure wiring. The HARD-GATE behavior is owned by task-2b's hook; this task wires the Phase H Step 1 commit step to invoke it so the gate fires on fix-bug commits — including Phase G fix sub-agent commits — per dd-2.)

Edit plugins/dso/skills/fix-bug/SKILL.md Phase H Step 1 (Commit and Close) to invoke the check-antipattern-scan-trailer.sh HARD-GATE as part of the commit step, so a fix-bug commit is refused when the Antipattern-Scan trailer is absent or a matches>0 scan lacks its per-match follow-up artifact. Reference the hook by its plugins/dso/hooks/check-antipattern-scan-trailer.sh path so the dangling-ref guard resolves it.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0) — Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0) — Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0) — Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] Phase H Step 1 wires the HARD-GATE hook by path — Verify: awk '/^## Phase H/{p=1} p' plugins/dso/skills/fix-bug/SKILL.md | grep -q 'check-antipattern-scan-trailer.sh'
- [ ] Phase H names the gate as a HARD-GATE on the commit step — Verify: awk '/^## Phase H/{p=1} p' plugins/dso/skills/fix-bug/SKILL.md | grep -qiE 'HARD-GATE|Antipattern-Scan trailer'
- [ ] Dangling-ref guard: every plugins/dso script/hook referenced in SKILL.md resolves to an executable file — Verify: grep -oE 'plugins/dso/(scripts|hooks)/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+\.sh' plugins/dso/skills/fix-bug/SKILL.md | sort -u | while read f; do test -x "$f" || { echo DANGLING:$f; exit 1; }; done
- [ ] TDD exemption: Rule 5 (behavioral-testing-standard) — instruction-file SKILL.md wiring; structural sequence ACs are the accepted standard. Verify: test -f plugins/dso/skills/shared/prompts/behavioral-testing-standard.md

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Wire Phase H Step 1 commit HARD-GATE invoking check-antipattern-scan-trailer.sh in SKILL.md
